instruction: Use the FreeCAD 1.1.1 GUI with the Path/CAM workbench. Open or import the initial CAD geometry file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/outer_plate.step. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Set the Job origin to the part top-face center. Use T1 to create a Profile operation on the outside contour, cutting along the outer boundary down to bottom Z=0.000 mm. Leave 0.2 mm radial stock and add one finish pass. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill for outside Profile milling, S9000 rpm, F650 mm/min. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-2.nc.
